title: Transportability target population: Arkansas
content: Figure 10.2(a) is the target-population causal graph for the effect of Advertisement X on Purchase Decision Y. Age Z confounds X and Y, while Click-through Rate W mediates X to Y.

variables.name: Purchase Decision (Y)
variables.content: Whether the consumer purchases the product.

variables.name: Age (Z)
variables.content: Age, a confounder of advertisement exposure and purchase.

variables.name: Click-through Rate (W)
variables.content: Clicking for more information, the mediator between advertisement and purchase.

arrows.because: Figure 10.2(a) draws Age as a cause of Advertisement exposure.
Figure 10.2(a) draws Age as a cause of Purchase Decision.
Figure 10.2(a) draws Advertisement as a cause of Click-through Rate.
Figure 10.2(a) draws Click-through Rate as a cause of Purchase Decision.
